body.text: Independent ATM operators run their back office on spreadsheets. Machines go offline invisibly, processor statements hide fee errors nobody reads, and cash forecasting is a manual second job. CashRoute replaces that spreadsheet with one screen.

Register each machine with its location and surcharge. Import a processor statement CSV and CashRoute flags the lines that look wrong — fees over 15% of gross, unregistered machines, volume swings of 40% or more. Log cash loads and get a days-remaining forecast per machine. Log outages and see trailing 30-day uptime. End the month with a per-machine report you can print.
